business_summary: Beijing Beetech Inc. provides optoelectronic instruments and intelligent sensor products, system solutions, and application services. It offers industrial process wireless monitoring, wireless mechanical parameter testing, and optical products; optoelectronic instruments; cold chain wireless temperature and humidity products; infrared thermal imager; and data connection services. The company also provides monitoring solutions for smart industry, digital oilfield, smart grid and other fields; and testing solutions for equipment manufacturing, scientific research and testing, and teaching and experimentation and national defense research. It serves emergency communications, cold chain logistics, and infrared monitoring industries. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Beijing, China.
